flow.body: Hi, Ana m {app_name}, an AI banking assistant that can help you with your banking needs. To get started, please complete the onboarding form below.

pre_onboarding.greeting: Nnọọ na {app_name}. Enwere m ike inyere gị aka na transfers, airtime/data, balances, na transaction history. Nke mbụ, ka anyị mezue account setup gị.
pre_onboarding.inquiry: Setup na-enyere m verify onye ị bụ ma jikọọ bank accounts gị n'udo. A na-encrypt details gị ma jiri ha naanị maka verification.
pre_onboarding.compliance: Ọ dị mma. Pịa bọtịnụ dị n'elu iji gaa n'ihu na account setup gị.
pre_onboarding.objection: Aghọtara m nchegbu gị. Setup dị mkpa tupu m nwee ike ịnweta banking information ma ọ bụ nyere gị aka na transactions.
pre_onboarding.banking_request: Enwere m ike inyere gị aka na nke ahụ mgbe setup gwụchara. Nke mbụ, ka anyị mechaa account setup gị.
pre_onboarding.out_of_scope: Ana m elekwasị anya na banking. Iji jiri Nenya, biko mezue account setup gị mbụ.
pre_onboarding.cooldown: Aga m anọ ebe a mgbe ị dị njikere. Pịa bọtịnụ oge ọ bụla iji gaa n'ihu na setup.
